name: notify
description: Browser and macOS notifications about what matters to you: a question for you, the hub's answer, a reply to your message, the result of your task, a reminder, a monitor's signal. A click opens the session; an answered question takes its notification away. While the hub tab is out of sight, its title shows the number of new ones and its icon a dot
why: No need to keep the hub tab in view or depend on Telegram: a question from the fleet is seen at once, even when the page is closed
